For n=qk+r every term divisible by 2^r. When s is one on all prefix qk positions, unique tiling J={1,1+k,...} gives ±2^r, even for q=0 (empty packing), proving sharp minimum and gcd. When r=0 the only maximal full tiling has odd residue, so all characters nonzero. When r=1, every maximum q-packing misses precisely one of holes 1,1+k,...,1+qk, giving W/2 mod2=(q+1)+sum s_(jk+1), balanced on half the characters, including n=1. Exact independent direct avoidance enumeration plus FWHT checked 216 complete spectra for all unbordered patterns k=2..5 and n=1..9. Finiteness is corroboration only; disjoint-packing argument proves all n,k.
